content: The project lean-CKMA (on GitHub) is my LLM-based effort to inventorize the core knowledge of mathematical analysis and to match it with results in Mathlib and TauCeti. The project is organized around a bibliography in 55 sections with sections 04 through 53 as the core. Mathematical synopses describe the core content and the matching structure files review the coverage in Mathlib and TauCeti for each area. The file GAPS.md reviews the principal core theorems that neither library proves and the file GAPS_EASY.md gives short derivations from library results for those entries of GAPS.md that have a short derivation. All the hard work in this project was done by LLM with Claude and GPT as joint first authors, Grok as a second reviewer and Gemini for occasional sanity checks.
This topic was moved here from #general > Core Knowledge of Mathematical Analysis in Mathlib+TauCeti by Kevin Buzzard.
Who is writing roadmaps for analysis for Tau Ceti? Is this useful to them? How could it be made useful to them?
